title: In Control
story:
A young man was preparing for an important job interview.

He had practiced for days.

He was confident, but also anxious.

On the way, his taxi got stuck in heavy traffic.

He looked at his watch again and again.

“I will be late,” he thought.

His heart started to panic.

He felt everything was going wrong.

But he decided to stay calm.

He closed his eyes and prayed quietly.

“God, I don’t know what will happen, but I trust You.”

After some delay, the traffic cleared.

He reached the office just in time.

Later, he learned the interview panel had also been delayed.

Everything aligned perfectly.

In life, we often feel things are out of control.

Delays.

Changes.

Unexpected situations.

But God is never surprised.

He knows the end from the beginning.

He is already there.

And He is guiding every step.
life_lesson:
God is in complete control of your life.

Trust Him even when things feel delayed or uncertain.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being in control of all things.

When I feel anxious or confused, help me trust You.

Remind me that You know the end from the beginning.

Give me peace in uncertain times.

Guide my steps according to Your plan.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you worry when things don’t go as planned?

Can you trust that God is already ahead of your situation?

What situation in your life do you need to surrender today?
verse:
I make known the end from the beginning.
From ancient times, what is still to come.
I say, ‘My purpose will stand.’
